title: Planning vs. Capability: Does Forward Planning Track Task Competence?

original_idea.body: Across Pythia checkpoints/sizes, correlate a logit-lens planning-strength metric with task accuracy to test whether planning emerges before, with, or after competence.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: if planning scales with capability, frontier gains bring stronger latent planning, sharpening the case for proactive monitoring (level 4).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Logit-lens metric + accuracy across Pythia checkpoints; guided, checkpoint handling overhead (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable but spans many checkpoints/sizes, a modest dependency (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public Pythia checkpoints, training-dynamics work labs deprioritize (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: Inference across checkpoints, no training; single GPU, manageable.
